contracts.prompt_snippet: MACHINE CONTRACT (required): emit one fenced ```positioning-json``` object with audience, job, alternatives, promise, proof, and assumptions. Proof must cite available evidence; unsupported claims belong in assumptions.

MACHINE CONTRACT (required): emit one fenced ```launch-plan-json``` object with segments, messages, channels, milestones, metrics, and owners. Every channel names its role, cost assumption, measurement, and stop/continue criterion.
